headline: Ryanair Warns of Potential Pay Freeze Amid Spiking Fuel Costs
summary: Ryanair warned it may freeze staff pay as fuel prices spike. The airline stated fuel costs could climb by €2 billion in 2028 unless conflict involving the US, Israel, and Iran comes to an end.
why: Ryanair is Europe's largest low-cost airline by passenger numbers, making its labor and fuel management closely watched indicators for European aviation margins.

impacts.name: Ryanair Holdings plc
impacts.why: Surging fuel expenses and potential labor friction pose risks to operating margins and earnings.
